field_definitions_key_slug.name: field_definitions_key_slug
field_definitions_key_slug.value: "field_definitions"."key" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9_]*' AND length("field_definitions"."key") BETWEEN 1 AND 64

media_types_id_slug.name: media_types_id_slug
media_types_id_slug.value: "media_types"."id" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9_]*' AND length("media_types"."id") BETWEEN 1 AND 64

consumptions_format.name: consumptions_format
consumptions_format.value: format IS NULL OR format IN ('print', 'ebook', 'audiobook', 'pdf', 'web', 'video', 'audio', 'other')

consumptions_dates.name: consumptions_dates
consumptions_dates.value: ("consumptions"."started_on" IS NULL OR "consumptions"."finished_on" IS NULL OR "consumptions"."started_on" <= "consumptions"."finished_on")
